analysis_status: Exploratory retrospective case study; design fixed before calculating event contrasts, not a new preregistered confirmation.
anchor_nature: Scheduled keynote start, not the nanosecond that every announcement first became public.
shock_calibration: Fixed common basis-point thresholds; no fitting on the event or on existing June 1-12 thresholds that include it.
quality_policy: Freshly verify original replay-cache and raw-source hashes, exact provenance/code, MBP-10 validation and native integer lattice; use event timestamps for matching, invalid/reset/atomic barriers for observability. Initialized quiet MBO books remain observed; no MBP quote-age cutoff.
latency_cohort_policy: At each horizon, require full observation after the source midpoint change in both venues; separately count already/no-prior-state/quality/end truncation. Each comparison window has its own exclusive end.
comparison_cohort_policy: Primary latency contrasts require all twenty intended directed pairs supported before and after; sensitivity uses all fifty-six pairs. Report insufficient coverage rather than silently varying the pair universe.
inference_policy: One scheduled keynote is one event. Summarize its pre/post change against six same-clock Monday reference-day changes and twenty-five broader reference changes. Descriptive ranks and reference IQRs are not p-values or causal confidence intervals. Reference days are not certified news-free.
limitations: Native cached midpoint changes cannot reconstruct bid/ask latency or exchange-clock timing; the 100-ms grid is used only for book quality, spread/depth and reconstruction checks.
Scheduled keynote start does not identify individual feature-reveal or public press-release times.
A single event cannot identify differences among product events, press releases, earnings calls and SEC filings.
No timestamp is invented for date-only press releases; no immediate-event conclusion is drawn from a non-overlapping morning window.
Receive clocks include feed transport, and counting leadership is not Hasbrouck information share or causal price discovery.
Raw and replay consistency checks cannot rule out all unreported upstream feed problems.
Event-window results depend on horizon, observable cohort, shock definition and venue universe.
